name: Pokémon Team Rocket: Jessie & James
storyline:
You are James from Team Rocket, and alongside Jessie and Meowth, you've traveled across the Kanto, Johto and Hoenn regions chasing after those brats (Ash, Brock, Misty, May...) to steal Pikachu. But everything is about to change...

After blasting off yet again, Team Rocket's Delibird appears with a letter from Giovanni. You'll stop chasing Pikachu (for the time being) to return to Kanto and carry out the missions assigned by the Boss. Basically, you'll be stealing Pokémon from trainers and items, investigating locations, thwarting enemy plans... In short, doing exactly what Team Rocket is supposed to do.
summary: Live the adventures of Team Rocket from the point of view of Jessie & James in an original story of their own, completing Giovanni's missions.
